answers.core: This is standard procedure for reliable software. I'm not sure _why_ there even is a difference between the two (only use-case I can think of is to soft-crash on errors in the release version, but hard-crash on errors in the debug version? But I'm not sure if that's behavior i would want as a game author).
answers.workaround: I do this myself: I link both the debug, as well as the release link of my `.gdextension` to the same binary.
